claim: The CloudHSM performance tables for hsm1.medium and hsm2m.medium both show approximate RSA 2048-bit signing performance of 2,000 ops/sec with two HSMs, 3,000 with three and 5,000 with six. To increase performance, you can add HSM instances to the cluster; performance varies with configuration, data size and application load.

qualifiers.scope: per cluster, by number of HSMs
qualifiers.condition: approximate figures; performance varies with configuration, data size and additional application load
